name: Lofty
tagline: AI-powered operating system for real estate agents and teams.
description: Lofty (formerly Chime) is an AI-powered platform for real estate professionals that unifies lead generation, CRM, IDX websites, a power dialer, and automation. Its agentic AI features — an AI Assistant, an AI Sales Agent (virtual ISA), Social Agent, and Homeowner Agent — engage leads, schedule appointments, and run follow-ups autonomously. It supports 70,000+ agents and is used by brokerages including Coldwell Banker, Berkshire Hathaway, eXp Realty, and Keller Williams.
insight: Rebranded from Chime Technologies to Lofty in November 2023, partly to end confusion with the Chime neobank.
edge: Bundles lead gen, CRM, IDX sites, and a power dialer with agentic AI agents (ISA, social, homeowner) for solo agents and teams in one OS.
cons: Feature breadth has a learning curve

references.title: To Elevate The Industry, Chime Becomes Lofty
